items.passage: Transcript: Hi, film society members, it's Tamsin Okafor. Our screenings are usually Thursday at seven in Room 252 of Northcote Hall, but the projector in 252 is out for repair this week, so we're borrowing Room 373 upstairs. Room 373 is booked on Thursday until eight thirty, so at first we planned a late start, Thursday at nine. Then our guest, the director of the documentary, told us she can only come on Friday, so the final plan is Friday at seven, in 373. One more thing. The building's front doors lock automatically after six. So I'll be standing just inside them from a quarter to seven to let everyone in, and if you're running late, text me and I'll come back down. Please don't try the side door; it sets off an alarm.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Film society] When will this week's screening begin?
items.explanation: The speaker says, 'the final plan is Friday at seven, in 373.' 'On Thursday at seven' is the usual schedule ('Our screenings are usually Thursday at seven'). 'On Thursday at nine' was the first plan ('at first we planned a late start, Thursday at nine'), replaced when the guest director could only come on Friday. 'On Friday at nine' combines the final day with the abandoned late start time.
